title: Monotonicity of tribes
statement: For all nonnegative integers $w$ and $s$, the tribes function on the Boolean cube of dimension $sw$ is monotone: if one input is coordinatewise at most another, then its output is at most the other's, with the signs ordered by $-1<1$.
